name: Cart Goal Booster
author: Local Site Builder

sections.description:
Cart Goal Booster is the lightweight, revenue-focused solution for WooCommerce stores. It displays a responsive progress bar that visualizes how close a customer is to unlocking “Free Shipping” (or any other cart total goal).

Stop losing sales because customers don’t know how close they are to a deal. Show them the goal, track their progress in real-time, and celebrate when they reach it.

🚀 Key Features (Free Version)

  • Real-Time Progress: Automatically updates as items are added/removed from the cart.
  • Sticky Position: Keep the goal visible at the Top or Bottom of the page.
  • Smart Messaging: Customize messages for “Empty Cart”, “In Progress”, and “Goal Achieved”.
  • Color Customization: Match your brand with custom background, text, and progress bar colors.
  • Lightweight: Built for performance. No bloat, no heavy frameworks.

🏆 Unlock More with Pro

Upgrade to Cart Goal Booster Pro for advanced features:
* Free Gifts: Automatically add a free product (hat, sticker, sample) to the cart when the goal is reached.
* Multi-Tier Goals: Set up to 3 different milestones (e.g., Reach $50 for Free Shipping, $100 for a Free Gift).
* Confetti Celebration: Fire a fun confetti animation when the goal is reached to delight customers.
* Tax Control: Choose whether to calculate goals based on Subtotal or Subtotal + Tax.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the cart-goal-booster folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Cart Goal Booster in the admin menu to configure your goal amount and colors.
sections.faq:
Does this work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes, the bar is injected via standard WordPress hooks (wp_footer or wp_body_open logic via CSS) and uses a high Z-Index to sit on top of most themes.

Can I use this for goals other than Free Shipping?

Absolutely. You can change the “Reward Name” text to anything you want, such as “Free Delivery,” “Discount Unlocked,” or “VIP Status.”
